## 1. Introduction
patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.1 bottom prints the superscript-1 footnote block '1Please cite as SIMA Team, 2025', 'Correspondence to: sima2-contact@google.com' and, under a rule, '© 2025 Google. All rights reserved' (visually verified at 200 dpi). The OCR dropped the whole block while keeping the superscript 1 on the byline 'SIMA Team, Google DeepMind $^{1}$', so the footnote text is restored after the Figure 1 caption, at the end of the page-1 content.

Rendered physical p.28 prints the BibTeX entry as five lines with the closing '}' on its own line (visually verified at 300 dpi). The OCR dropped the closing brace, glued author={{SIMA Team}}, onto the title line and inserted blank lines inside the entry.

Rendered physical p.28 prints 'Alphabetical by first name.' as a plain note line under the 'SIMA 2 Team' heading, not as a section heading (visually verified together with the p28 team block). The OCR promoted it to a level-2 heading, which pollutes the reader outline.

Rendered physical p.28 prints 'Please cite as:' as an italic lead-in sentence above the BibTeX entry, not as a section heading (visually verified at 300 dpi). The OCR promoted it to a level-2 heading.

The Ball et al. (Genie 3) author list is one continuous reference running from physical p.28 ('... H. Ran, T. Salimans,') onto physical p.29 ('M. Sanchez, I. Saprykin, ...', verified at 300 dpi). The OCR turned the page break into a paragraph break, splitting the reference in two.

Rendered physical p.32 line-breaks the Eureka reference as 'A. Anand-' / 'kumar.' (visually verified at 400 dpi); the same author is printed 'A. Anandkumar' in the Minedojo (p.30) and Voyager (p.35) references. The OCR glued the line-break hyphen into the surname.

Rendered physical p.28 Anthropic reference prints the URL ending 'Model_Card_Claude_3.pdf' with plain underscores (visually verified at 300 dpi); the backslash-underscore sequences are OCR Markdown escapes that alter the visible URL.

The J. Zhang 'Gemini Plays Pokemon' Twitch URL is printed with plain underscores (PDF text layer p.36; same escape class as the p.28 Anthropic URL verified at 300 dpi). The backslash-underscore sequences are OCR Markdown escapes that alter the visible URL.
